This existing real snapshot covers evaluator, hydraulic, phase, merit, trial, materializer, final assembly, work, physical budget, and exact Option owner binding. The scratch helper then overwrites both refusal values with the same decoded pre-call array. The negative unchanged-state assertion is therefore copied-input tautology rather than observation of the failing runtime path.
findings.minimal_required_correction: Take the observation trace before returning the refinement refusal, store its actual live_state_entry/live_state_exit in the refusal, and remove the outer copied-before overwrite. Assert those actual values are equal for every negative mutation.
